dlg.bram.hello.speaker: bram
dlg.bram.hello.text: Welcome to the Gilded Heron! Warm stew, dry beds and, saints forgive me, rats the size of hounds in my cellar.

dlg.bram.rats.speaker: bram
dlg.bram.rats.text: Came up through the old drain, I reckon. One of them bit my pot-boy. I locked the cellar and I have not slept since. Clear them out and there is coin in it for you.

dlg.bram.accept.speaker: bram
dlg.bram.accept.text: Bless you. Here is the key. The cellar door is just there, in the far wall.

dlg.bram.accept_bonus.speaker: bram
dlg.bram.accept_bonus.text: You drive a hard bargain for someone who has not seen them yet. Done. Coin and a potion. Here is the key.

dlg.bram.accept_plain.speaker: bram
dlg.bram.accept_plain.text: Coin is what I have. Here is the key. The cellar door is in the far wall.

dlg.bram.waiting.speaker: bram
dlg.bram.waiting.text: Still scratching down there. The key is in your pack, and the door is in the far wall.

dlg.bram.report.speaker: bram
dlg.bram.report.text: Quiet! Blessed quiet. Here, you have earned every copper.

dlg.bram.done.speaker: bram
dlg.bram.done.text: Stew is on. Sit anywhere you like.

dlg.bram.rumor.speaker: bram
dlg.bram.rumor.text: Old Elsbeth's boy went up there on a dare and never came down. She waits in the square every evening, poor soul.

dlg.brunhild.hello.speaker: brunhild
dlg.brunhild.hello.text: Stonefather's peace on you. I am Brunhild Stonehymn. If you have come about the dead, you are the first to come to the right place.

dlg.brunhild.lore.speaker: brunhild
dlg.brunhild.lore.text: The old king was buried with a crown that was never his to keep. Someone has put a hand on it. I feel it like a tooth going bad.

dlg.brunhild.impressed.speaker: brunhild
dlg.brunhild.impressed.text: Not failed. Cut. Somebody who knew the words unsaid them. You know your rites, friend. Good. I am tired of explaining.

dlg.brunhild.not_quite.speaker: brunhild
dlg.brunhild.not_quite.text: Failed? Hah. I laid those rites myself and they do not fail. They were cut. There is a difference, and it is a worse one.

dlg.brunhild.join.speaker: brunhild
dlg.brunhild.join.text: I have been waiting three weeks for someone foolish enough to go up there with me. Let me fetch my mace.

dlg.edrin.captive.speaker: narrator
dlg.edrin.captive.text: A young man is chained to the wall, eyes wide above a gag. He shakes his head at you: not yet. Not while they are watching.

dlg.edrin.free.speaker: edrin
dlg.edrin.free.text: You are alive. You are ALIVE. They were going to give me to him. The Hollow King. He is below, past the stair. He talks to the dead and they answer.

dlg.edrin.know.speaker: edrin
dlg.edrin.know.text: His name is Varrek. He was a hedge-wizard from the mere villages before he found the crown. The dead things beside him are only puppets. He holds their strings.

dlg.edrin.tended.speaker: edrin
dlg.edrin.tended.text: Thank you. Listen. He said a rite over them every night and I heard all of it. The words run backwards from the ones carved on the altar. Say them forwards and the strings are cut. I am sure of it.

dlg.edrin.go.speaker: edrin
dlg.edrin.go.text: Home. Yes. I am never taking a dare again.

dlg.elsbeth.hello.speaker: elsbeth
dlg.elsbeth.hello.text: Have you seen a boy? Sandy hair, a laugh like a goose. My Edrin. He went up to the Barrow three nights ago.

dlg.elsbeth.confess.speaker: elsbeth
dlg.elsbeth.confess.text: He went for me. I told him his father's ring was buried with the old dead up there. It was a story. It was only ever a story.

dlg.elsbeth.nothing.speaker: elsbeth
dlg.elsbeth.nothing.text: There is nothing to tell. He is a good boy. He is only late.

dlg.elsbeth.promise.speaker: elsbeth
dlg.elsbeth.promise.text: Bring him home. Please. I will be here. I am always here.

dlg.elsbeth.waiting.speaker: elsbeth
dlg.elsbeth.waiting.text: Is there word? No. No, of course. I will wait.

dlg.elsbeth.thanks.speaker: elsbeth
dlg.elsbeth.thanks.text: He is home. He is HOME, and eating everything in the house. Take this. It was his father's, and it kept him safe at sea for thirty years.

dlg.elsbeth.after.speaker: elsbeth
dlg.elsbeth.after.text: Saints keep you, wherever you walk.

dlg.gate_guard.hello.speaker: gate_guard
dlg.gate_guard.hello.text: East road is open, if you can call it that. It goes to the Barrow and nowhere else, these days.

dlg.gate_guard.seen.speaker: gate_guard
dlg.gate_guard.seen.text: Green lights, most nights. And once a man walking up the road who I helped bury last winter. I did not call out.

dlg.gate_guard.goblins.speaker: gate_guard
dlg.gate_guard.goblins.text: Goblins in the old orchard, behind the hedge there. Captain says leave them be while the Barrow is glowing. Tova at the smithy says otherwise, loudly.

dlg.gate_guard.after.speaker: gate_guard
dlg.gate_guard.after.text: No lights last night. First time in a month. Whatever you did, do you want a drink?

dlg.kaelen.hello.speaker: kaelen
dlg.kaelen.hello.text: You have the look of someone about to do something dangerous. Kaelen Ashford. I guard caravans, when there are caravans.

dlg.kaelen.story.speaker: kaelen
dlg.kaelen.story.text: The east road is closed and the merchants have gone home. A sword that is not earning is just a heavy stick.

dlg.kaelen.offer.speaker: kaelen
dlg.kaelen.offer.text: The Barrow. Of course it is the Barrow. What is the split?

dlg.kaelen.join.speaker: kaelen
dlg.kaelen.join.text: Equal shares, then. You have my sword.

dlg.kaelen.join_glad.speaker: kaelen
dlg.kaelen.join_glad.text: ...It does, does it not. All right. For the town. But I still want my share.

dlg.pip.hello.speaker: pip
dlg.pip.hello.text: Before you ask: no, I did not, and you cannot prove it. Pip Underbough. Locks, ledgers and ladders a speciality.

dlg.pip.caught.speaker: pip
dlg.pip.caught.text: ...Fine. Fine! Here. I was only seeing how heavy it was. You have good eyes. I like good eyes.

dlg.pip.missed.speaker: narrator
dlg.pip.missed.text: She smiles at you with both hands in plain sight. You feel faintly lighter, somehow.

dlg.pip.job.speaker: pip
dlg.pip.job.text: A tomb? An old one, with old locks, and nobody alive to mind? I am in. Half of whatever is not nailed down.

dlg.pip.join.speaker: pip
dlg.pip.join.text: Tight-fisted. Sensible. I can work with sensible. Lead on.

dlg.reeve.hello.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.hello.text: You must be the one the gate sent word about. Good. I am Maren Aldous, Reeve of Hollowmere, and I am very nearly out of people to ask.

dlg.reeve.trouble.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.trouble.text: Three weeks ago, lights began to burn on the Barrow, east of here. Then our dead stopped staying buried. Then the living began to vanish. The miller's boy, Edrin, was the last.

dlg.reeve.barrow.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.barrow.text: A tomb older than the town. They say a king lies in it who would not share his hall, not even with death. We left it alone, and it left us alone. Until now.

dlg.reeve.pay.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.pay.text: One hundred and fifty gold when the Barrow is quiet. It is most of what the town has.

dlg.reeve.pay_more.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.pay_more.text: ...Two hundred, then. And my thanks, which are worth rather less.

dlg.reeve.pay_no.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.pay_no.text: I cannot give you what we do not have. One hundred and fifty.

dlg.reeve.accept.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.accept.text: Then take some advice with you. Do not go alone. There is a sellsword idling by the well, a quick-fingered halfling at the Gilded Heron, and Sister Brunhild keeps the shrine. A scholar has been camping in the pines outside the walls, too. Make your own camp there. When you are ready, the east gate leads to the Barrow.

dlg.reeve.again.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.again.text: The east gate leads to the Barrow. Make camp first, and do not go alone.

dlg.reeve.barrow_again.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.barrow_again.text: A king who would not share his hall, even with death. Whatever has woken up in there, it is using his name.

dlg.reeve.victory.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.victory.text: The lights went out an hour ago. I stood on the wall and watched them go. It is done, then? Truly done?

dlg.reeve.after.speaker: reeve
dlg.reeve.after.text: The Barrow is dark and the churchyard is quiet. Sleep well, friend. You have earned it.

dlg.snagrot.hello.speaker: snagrot
dlg.snagrot.hello.text: Oi! Longshanks! These are Snagrot's apples, Snagrot's fire, Snagrot's box. You want box? You give shinies. Or you give blood.

dlg.snagrot.flee.speaker: snagrot
dlg.snagrot.flee.text: Gah! Snagrot was leaving anyway. Stupid box. Stupid apples. Stupid longshanks!

dlg.snagrot.trade.speaker: snagrot
dlg.snagrot.trade.text: Fifteen shinies! For a box of rocks! Hee! Snagrot is a GENIUS. Take it, take it.

dlg.snagrot.haggle.speaker: snagrot
dlg.snagrot.haggle.text: Fifteen? Box is heavy. Heavy is THIRTY.

dlg.snagrot.trade_thirty.speaker: snagrot
dlg.snagrot.trade_thirty.text: Thirty! Snagrot is a genius TWICE.

dlg.thessaly.hello.speaker: thessaly
dlg.thessaly.hello.text: Oh. People. I had hoped the smoke would keep them away. Thessaly Wren. I am studying the Barrow's wards, from a sensible distance.

dlg.thessaly.lore.speaker: thessaly
dlg.thessaly.lore.text: The lights are not random. They pulse, like breath. Something down there is being woken slowly, by someone patient.

dlg.thessaly.impressed.speaker: thessaly
dlg.thessaly.impressed.text: Yes! Exactly! Feeding them, a little every night. Finally, someone who reads. I have so many notes to show you.

dlg.thessaly.corrected.speaker: thessaly
dlg.thessaly.corrected.text: Abjuration, originally. Necromancy is what somebody has turned them into. But you are close, which is more than I expected.

dlg.thessaly.join.speaker: thessaly
dlg.thessaly.join.text: You want me to walk into a tomb. With you. ...Yes. Obviously yes. Let me get my book.

dlg.thessaly.camp.speaker: thessaly
dlg.thessaly.camp.text: Back already? I was just getting comfortable.

dlg.tova.hello.speaker: tova
dlg.tova.hello.text: Mind the sparks. Tova Ironhand. If it has an edge or a hinge in this town, I made it.

dlg.tova.trouble.speaker: tova
dlg.tova.trouble.text: My iron came up the east road two days ago. Goblins took the cart at the bridge. The guard says they are squatting in the old orchard, bold as crows. Without that crate I am making nails out of horseshoes.

dlg.tova.reward.speaker: tova
dlg.tova.reward.text: A warhammer off my own wall. Blades skate off the things walking out of that Barrow. A hammer does not.

dlg.tova.accept.speaker: tova
dlg.tova.accept.text: The orchard is south-east of the square, through the gap in the hedge. They are goblins: they understand fear, and they understand shiny things.

dlg.tova.waiting.speaker: tova
dlg.tova.waiting.text: South-east of the square, behind the hedge. Mind the one with the bow.

dlg.tova.return.speaker: tova
dlg.tova.return.text: That is my mark on the lid! Ha! Here, as promised. Hit something dead with it.

dlg.tova.done.speaker: tova
dlg.tova.done.text: Forge is hot and the iron is good. What do you need?

dlg.varrek.hello.speaker: varrek
dlg.varrek.hello.text: Visitors. How long it has been since anyone climbed down here to bow. I am Varrek, and this hall belongs to the Hollow King. Which is to say: to me.

dlg.varrek.why.speaker: varrek
dlg.varrek.why.text: Because I was nobody. A hedge-wizard curing warts in the mere villages. And then I found a crown with no one in it. The dead do not laugh at me. The dead do as they are told.

dlg.varrek.unbind.speaker: narrator
dlg.varrek.unbind.text: The words taste of dust and cold iron. The two dead things beside the altar fold up like dropped coats.

dlg.varrek.startled.speaker: varrek
dlg.varrek.startled.text: The militia? Here? They would not dare. They... how many?

dlg.varrek.mock.speaker: varrek
dlg.varrek.mock.text: Was that meant to frighten me? You stand in my hall and stammer. Kneel.

dlg.varrek.fight.speaker: varrek
dlg.varrek.fight.text: Then you will kneel the hard way.

cs.barrow_enter.1.speaker: narrator
cs.barrow_enter.1.text: Cold air breathes up out of the Barrow, and with it a smell of old stone and older dust.

cs.barrow_enter.2.speaker: narrator
cs.barrow_enter.2.text: Somewhere ahead, bone scrapes on stone. You are not alone down here.

cs.ending.1.speaker: reeve
cs.ending.1.text: Then Hollowmere owes you more than it can pay. But it will pay what it promised.

cs.ending.2.speaker: reeve
cs.ending.2.text: Tonight the lamps stay lit because we want them lit. Go and rest. You have earned a quiet night.

cs.intro.1.speaker: narrator
cs.intro.1.text: Dusk settles over Hollowmere, and nobody lights a lamp they do not have to.

cs.intro.2.speaker: narrator
cs.intro.2.text: For three weeks green lights have burned on the Barrow, and the town's dead have not rested. The Reeve has sent for help.

cs.king_falls.1.speaker: narrator
cs.king_falls.1.text: Varrek falls, and the green fire in the braziers gutters and goes out.

cs.king_falls.2.speaker: narrator
cs.king_falls.2.text: All through the Barrow, the dead lie down. On the altar, a black iron crown sits very still.

cs.king_reveal.1.speaker: varrek
cs.king_reveal.1.text: ...and the hall shall have its king again.

cs.king_reveal.2.speaker: narrator
cs.king_reveal.2.text: The robed figure turns from the altar. Two dead men turn with him.
